feeds.title: Car Time Auto Blog
feeds.description: Get tips and advice for selling used cars, buyers' guide, maintenance tips, market updates, and more! Car Time, your one-stop auto experience, has been proudly serving Tucson and the surrounding area for 30 years. We offer all makes and models.

feeds.title: Perez Auto Repair Blog
feeds.description: Marcello Perez opened Perez Auto Repair in Phoenix, Arizona in 1976 with a mission to serve his community. Working from his home garage, he proved that he could provide something other auto shops couldn't honest and affordable automotive services. Today, it is still a proud family-owned and operated business, and they continue to provide honest, reliable services. Follow their auto blog for valuable information regarding your vehicle maintenance, driving tips and more.

feeds.title: Courtesy Chevrolet Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Courtesy Chevrolet blog your place for Chevrolet news and reviews. Brought to you by Courtesy Chevrolet.Now in the 21st Century, Courtesy Chevrolet is proudly bringing the Newest Chevrolet line up, and top notch Certified Pre-Owned vehicles to our guest in fun and exciting new ways.

feeds.title: Red Mountain Funding Blog
feeds.description: Red Mountain Funding Auto are not a car dealership. They are a financing company. With 20+ years in the car biz we work with all individuals who need help buying a car! Their blog offers auto resources, car culture, purchasing and DIY auto repair tips, as well as the latest information on car-buying and financing in Arizona.

feeds.title: Accurate Automotive AZ Blog
feeds.description: Providing quality auto repair in Arizona since 1992. Accurate Automotive is a family owned business delivering honest and professional auto repair and maintenance services.

feeds.title: Drive Now AZ Blog
feeds.description: Drive Now AZ Blog specializes in providing auto loans for people with various types of credit. Get access to Phoenix's number-one auto dealers and follow this blog to get insight on the latest used car deals, travel tips, safety updates, and more!

feeds.title: Auto House Blog
feeds.description: Auto House sets the new standard for operations and customer service in the car sales industry. They are on a mission to change minds about car sales: one person, one car, one sale at a time. Uncover more through the blog and catch up on their cars, car reviews, buying guides, technical information, industry insights, latest news, updates, services, and more.

feeds.title: Scottsdale Muffler & Automotive Blog
feeds.description: Scottsdale Muffler repairs cars in Scottsdale, Tempe, Mesa, and the surrounding areas. Scottsdale Muffler does everything from fixing and replacing engines and transmissions, and muffler repair, to changing oil and tuning up your vehicle so it doesn't need the more expensive repairs.

feeds.title: Barrett-Jackson
feeds.description: Specializing in providing products and services to collector car owners, astute collectors and automotive enthusiasts worldwide. Barrett-Jackson produces 'The World's Greatest Collector and Classic Car Auctions' in Scottsdale, Palm Beach, Northeast, and Las Vegas.
